description: This file defines the FFNetworkManager class for managing network requests and responses in Firefox within the Playwright project. It handles request interception, response processing, and request lifecycle events.

classes.name: FFNetworkManager
classes.description: Manages network requests and responses for Firefox in Playwright.

classes.name: InterceptableRequest
classes.description: Represents an interceptable network request, supporting redirection tracking.

classes.name: FFRouteImpl
classes.description: Implements network route handling for request continuation, fulfillment, and abort.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Removes all event listeners associated with the network manager.

methods.name: setRequestInterception
methods.description: Enables or disables request interception and cache disabling.

methods.name: _onRequestWillBeSent
methods.description: Handles the event when a request is about to be sent.

methods.name: _onResponseReceived
methods.description: Processes received responses, including fetching response bodies and timing info.

methods.name: _onRequestFinished
methods.description: Handles the completion of a request, including redirect handling.

methods.name: _onRequestFailed
methods.description: Handles failed requests, cleaning up request state.
